stories.title: North Wales pays Britain’s highest electricity standing charge, and new energy plans won’t change it
stories.summary: The UK Government plans to scrap the daily standing charge on household gas bills, but the electricity standing charge, where north Wales pays more than anywhere else in Great Britain, is not included. stories.title: Employers to be legally required to publish salaries in job adverts
stories.summary: Employers are to be legally required to publish salaries in job adverts under plans announced by the UK Government. Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced the change on Thursday, saying jobseekers should know what a job pays before applying for it. stories.title: River Dee only Welsh river where nitrate has risen in 25 years, analysis finds
stories.summary: The River Dee is the only river in Wales where nitrate levels have risen over the past 25 years, according to an analysis of Natural Resources Wales records by the charity Afonydd Cymru. stories.title: Senedd rejects calls to ban phones in classrooms
stories.summary: The Senedd has rejected a Reform UK call for a legal ban on mobile phones in classrooms across Wales. Members voted 50 to 38 against the motion on Wednesday, 4 November, after a debate in the Siambr. stories.summary: North Wales Police’s online reporting and webchat services are likely to be affected for several hours on Friday morning because of planned maintenance work.
